added.msgid: Construction is an internal integration boundary. Generated Platform preparation constructs fresh owner storage once, copies the selected Core clock face without invoking its time reader, and opens admission. Later starts of the constructed owner use explicit private reopen. External products use public and generated headers, not private provider constructors. The RTC initially stays unset until an explicit public set.

added.msgid: `native (MODEL; physical=false)` 行只投影当前 resolver 实际选择并生成的 Native 软件模型，不声明物理外设数量、引脚、IRQ、Board 路线或实板能力；对应路线与 Board 列因此为空。未选择的主机模型库存不进入本表。
added.msgstr: Rows marked `native (MODEL; physical=false)` project only Native software models actually selected and generated by the current resolver. They establish no physical peripheral counts, pins, IRQs, Board routes or board capability; their route and Board columns are therefore empty. Unselected host-model inventory is omitted.
